headline: See what your agents actually did
lede: Follow tool calls, handoffs, and failures across a run without scraping raw logs.
summary: A console for operators who need a clear trace of every agent step.
about: Agent Observability Console turns a run into a timeline of prompts, tools, and outcomes. Slow steps and repeated retries stand out.
The sample traces come from a support agent, a research agent, and a nightly batch job.
